howto: Pick RACES or CLASSIC and press Start. You auto-run: snatch floating material and hold (or Down) to lay planks over each gap.
Tap or press Space to hop cones. The rival builder races you to the flag.
Stars: reach the flag, finish ahead of the rival, win by a margin. Coins buy bridge styles.
tips: Keep a few planks spare: every cone you run into knocks material loose.
Races get longer and the rival lays planks faster; every five races a new world begins.
A daily goal pays coins once a day; the week stamps light on consecutive days.

controls.keyboard: Space, W or Up to hop; hold S, Down or J to build; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap to hop; press and hold at a gap to build; the pause button sits bottom right

difficulty: Race N is 220+55(N-1) m (up to the classic 620 m); the rival lays faster each race and the winning margin for three stars grows. Classic is the original 620 m race.

cheats.effect: Planks cost nothing: every gap bridges itself
The rival builder works at three-quarter speed
Cones cost no material and never trip you

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere on the title (or Space) to start
features.instant-restart: Race again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best on the title card and a live Best cell in the HUD (starred when you pass it)
features.tutorial-card: A skippable coach card at the first gap on the first run; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Result card with stars, score, coins, material and place
features.levels: RACES mode with a race picker and stars per race; CLASSIC keeps the original race
features.stars: Three stars per race (reach the flag, beat the rival, win by a margin)
features.worlds: Five worlds that retint the sea and the sky legs
features.unlocks: Nine bridge styles: free, stars, coins, level or day-streak unlocks
features.daily-goal: One seeded daily goal with a coin reward, week stamps and a day streak

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card. High: up to 2x pixel ratio and soft shadows; Low: 1x, no shadow pass and half the island scenery.
